name: capture.claim
description: Claims a reel or a post a linked sender shared with the capture account, under the id made from Meta's message id, for the person they are linked to. A claim made before (Meta sends again) or an unlinked sender answers no person, and nothing is done twice. Internal: packages/connect's webhook, as the principal META_WEBHOOK_AS names.
sql: with s as (select x.user_id, x.name from brandbase.capture_senders x where x.account = :account and x.sender = :sender and x.user_id is not null), c as (insert into brandbase.captures (id, account, sender, user_id, name, created_at) select :id, :account, :sender, s.user_id, coalesce(s.name, ''), :now::timestamptz from s on conflict (id) do nothing returning user_id) select jsonb_build_object('userId', (select user_id from c)) as result
